title: PhysCapBench: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Physically Grounded Video Captioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16424v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical AI aims to learn transferable physical knowledge from real-world experience to understand, predict, and act in the physical world. Internet videos and embodied demonstrations provide complementary observations of motion, interaction, and state evolution. A foundational data challenge is to measure and preserve this physical information as training supervision. In video-language pretraining, captions express observed processes in language, yet a semantically correct description can omit the interactions and transitions that define those processes. Rich physical experience in video does not automatically translate into sufficient language supervision. This gap calls for a yardstick to assess annotation quality, compare captioning strategies, and guide training-data refinement. translated_title: PhysCapBench：面向物理接地视频描述的跨领域基准测试集
translated_abstract: 物理AI旨在从现实世界的经验中学习可迁移的物理知识，以理解、预测并在物理世界中行动。互联网视频和具身演示为运动、交互和状态演化提供了互补的观察。一个基础性的数据挑战是如何测量并保存这些物理信息作为训练监督。在视频-语言预训练中，描述用语言表达观察到的过程，然而语义上正确的描述可能省略定义这些过程的交互与状态转变。视频中丰富的物理经验并不会自动转化为充分的语言监督。这一差距呼吁需要一个衡量标准来评估标注质量、比较不同的描述策略，并指导训练数据的精炼优化。受我们为世界模型预训练构建数据工作的启发，我们提出了PhysCapBench，据我们所知这是第一个统一的物理描述基准（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了PhysCapBench，据我们所知是首个统一的跨领域物理描述基准，用于衡量视频标注中物理信息的保留程度，评估标注质量、比较描述策略并指导物理AI训练数据的精炼。
en_tdlr: We introduce PhysCapBench, the first unified cross-domain benchmark for physically grounded video captioning, providing a yardstick to assess annotation quality, compare captioning strategies, and guide training-data refinement for Physical AI.
